scripts.build: esbuild editor-src/ssg-builder.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=SsgBuilder --jsx=automatic --outfile=app/ssg-builder.bundle.js && esbuild editor-src/puck-layout-editor.jsx --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=PuckLayoutEditor --jsx=automatic --outfile=app/puck-layout-editor.bundle.js && esbuild editor-src/puck-content-editor.jsx --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=PuckContentEditor --jsx=automatic --outfile=app/puck-content-editor.bundle.js && node scripts/build-html.mjs
scripts.e2e:up: docker compose -f tests/docker-compose.yml down -v --remove-orphans; docker compose -f tests/docker-compose.yml up -d && node tests/seed.mjs
scripts.e2e:test: npm run build && playwright test -c tests/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.e2e: npm run e2e:up && npm run e2e:test; status=$?; npm run e2e:down; exit $status
scripts.e2e:gitlab:up: docker compose -f tests/docker-compose.gitlab.yml down -v --remove-orphans; docker compose -f tests/docker-compose.gitlab.yml up -d && node tests/seed-gitlab.mjs
scripts.e2e:gitlab:test: npm run build && playwright test -c tests/playwright.gitlab.config.mjs
scripts.e2e:gitlab: npm run e2e:gitlab:up && npm run e2e:gitlab:test; status=$?; npm run e2e:gitlab:down; exit $status
